description: Defines the class AOTIModelContainerRunnerCuda, a CUDA-specific implementation for running model containers within the torch::inductor namespace. It provides constructors, a destructor, and methods to run models using CUDA streams.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerCuda
classes.description: A CUDA-specific runner class for model containers that extends AOTIModelContainerRunner, providing methods to execute models on CUDA devices and streams.

methods.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerCuda
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the runner with model path, target device, number of models, CUDA device string, optional CUBIN directory, and threading mode.

methods.name: run_impl
methods.description: Executes the model container with given input handles and stream handle, returning output tensors.

methods.name: run_with_cuda_stream
methods.description: Runs the model using a specific CUDA stream with provided inputs.
